name: Haguro (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Haguro town emblem in white: two angular stylised characters side by side, like arrowheads.
history: Flag of the former town of Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1962.

features.role: Haguro town emblem — two angular stylised characters side by side, like arrowheads
